name: Myasthenia Gravis
definition: Autoimmune neuromuscular-junction disorder causing fluctuating, fatigable skeletal-muscle weakness, often affecting ocular, bulbar, limb or respiratory muscles.

typical: Bulbar symptoms such as dysarthria or dysphagia
Symptoms often worsen with exertion and improve with rest

redFlags.item: Dyspnea, weak cough or rapidly worsening generalized weakness suggesting myasthenic crisis
Significant dysphagia, aspiration risk or inability to handle secretions
Rapid deterioration after infection, surgery or medication exposure

core: Neck flexion and proximal limb strength
Respiratory assessment when generalized weakness is present
Reflexes and sensation, usually preserved in uncomplicated MG

investigations.principle: Diagnosis combines characteristic clinical fatigability with antibody, electrodiagnostic and cause-directed assessment.
investigations.MRI: Brain imaging is selected when central mimics are suspected; chest imaging is used to evaluate thymoma according to clinical pathway.
investigations.radiographs: Plain radiographs are not diagnostic; electrophysiology and serology are more relevant.

green: Energy conservation and individualized rehabilitation when stable
Vaccination/infection prevention and medication safety review
amber: Pyridostigmine, immunotherapy, thymectomy and biologic treatment require individualized specialist assessment and monitoring.
red: Suspected myasthenic crisis requires emergency respiratory and neurological management; Ayurvedic or routine outpatient treatment must not delay it.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Balakshaya/Vata-neuromuscular phenotype may be explored only as a parallel individualized framework; myasthenia gravis remains a specific neuromuscular-junction diagnosis.

patientEducation.summary: Myasthenia gravis causes fluctuating muscle weakness that can worsen with exertion. New breathing or swallowing difficulty is an emergency.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent emergency assessment for breathing difficulty, severe swallowing difficulty, rapidly worsening weakness or inability to manage secretions.
